items.jp: その主な産業は、緑茶の生産だった。

translation.pt-BR: A principal indústria de lá era a produção de chá verde.
translation.en: The main industry there was the production of green tea.

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は marks 「その主な産業」as the topic of the sentence ('as for the main industry...'), about which the rest makes its statement.
tokens: prenominal determiner (連体詞), modifies 産業
modifier (of the following noun, via の)
